name: The Weird One
source: Camille has made up her mind and plans to confess her feelings to a friend of hers. However, what she doesn't know is that this guy is much weirder than she thinks. Whatever choices she makes will have a huge effect on whatever universe she's in. Some decisions may allow her to continue to have a normal life but others will throw her in all kinds of weird situations. Will Camille be able to tell Dave how he she feels about him or will he drag him into whatever weird things are going on with him?
translation: 卡米尔已经下定决心，并计划向她的一位朋友坦白自己的感受。然而她不知道的是，这个家伙比她想象的要古怪得多。无论她做出什么选择，都会对她所处的宇宙产生巨大影响。有些决定可能会让她继续过正常的生活，但另一些决定会让她陷入各种奇怪的境地。卡米尔能否告诉戴夫她对他的感觉，或者戴夫会把他拖进他身上发生的任何奇怪的事情中吗？
